visual.general_description: Close-up photograph of an eye with purple-blue stained patches around the corneal margin.
visual.detailed_description: Close-up color photograph of an eye on a black background. The eyelid margin and lashes run along the top; the conjunctiva and sclera are reddish-pink and the cornea is hazy orange-pink. Several purple-blue stained patches lie around the corneal margin: a larger irregular patch at the upper left, a small separate patch at the left lower side, and a patch at the bottom with a smaller speckled purple area beside it. A small round teal-blue spot and a bright white light reflection lie near the center of the cornea. No text, scale, arrows, panel letters or dates are printed.

visual.general_description: Composite of five photographs of donor cornea preparation and operative views.
visual.detailed_description: Composite color figure of five unlettered photographs: two on the top row and three on the bottom row. Top left: a donor corneal button mounted on a blue circular holder with a white sponge-like ring; the cornea is pale and translucent, and a flat tan strip-shaped instrument lies across it, held by a thin metal handle entering from the right edge. Top right: a close-up of an eye with intensely red conjunctiva and engorged vessels, a large grayish-white opaque cornea with a greenish-gray center, a small brown speck near the top of the cornea, and a thick white-grayish region at the upper part. Bottom left: a surgical field with red conjunctiva, a metal wire eyelid retractor on both sides and forceps or instruments holding tissue near a small round pale structure. Bottom middle: a pale grayish-white round graft over the cornea held by a ring of fine dark radial sutures, with a bright light reflection near its center and red conjunctiva around it. Bottom right: an operated eye held open by a wire retractor, with a darker red crescent-shaped area and a small round pale central structure with bright reflections. No printed text, panel letters, scale bars or dates are visible.

visual.general_description: OCT cross-section with thickness labels beside an eye photograph with clock-hour overlay.
visual.detailed_description: Wide figure made of two screenshot-like images side by side on a dark background. Left: an anterior-segment optical coherence tomography cross-section showing an arched grayish band of corneal tissue. A list of four small boxed labels at the upper left reads "Epithelium", "Bowman", "Endothelium" and a green-highlighted "Cornea" (small and only partly legible). Green text at the top center reads "Averaging success rate: 4/4", and at the upper right a green arrow points to a green "1". A yellow rectangle sits over the upper central part of the band, with a green vertical thickness line through the center labelled "1006"; a green slanted line at the left end is labelled with a four-digit number that is too blurred to read with confidence, and a green slanted line at the right end is labelled "1101". No units are printed. A grayscale gradient bar runs along the bottom. Right: a grayscale infrared-style photograph of an eye with eyelashes at the top, a dark pupil in the center and bright white reflection patches below it. A green ring of clock-hour numerals 1 to 12 surrounds the pupil, with a green horizontal arrow pointing from the right edge of the ring toward the left. A white filled circle lies at the lower edge below this image.
